## Ctx.renderBroadcastPoll() method

Sends a template poll to multiple users in bulk.

**Signature:**

```typescript
renderBroadcastPoll(ids: number[], languageCode: string[], keyboard?: ITInBoKb | null, data?: ITData | null, AGBaseId?: string | null, options?: Parameters<Ctx[`replyWithPoll`]>[2] | null, throwError?: boolean | null, chunkSize?: number | null, chunkDelayMs?: number | null, excludeIds?: number[] | null, onProgress?: ((done: number, total: number) => void | Promise<void>) | null, startFrom?: number | null, concurrency?: number | null): Promise<{
        successCount: number;
        failedCount: number;
        totalCount: number;
        skippedCount: number;
        retryable: Array<{
            index: number;
            id: number;
            error: unknown;
        }>;
    }>;
```

**Returns:**

Counts plus `retryable[]` for a re-drive pass.

## Remarks

Poll counterpart of `renderBroadcastMedia`<!-- -->: the same checkpoint-first loop (per-language `getGPoll` compilation, fail-fast `Ctx.assertPoll` for every recipient BEFORE the loop, `startFrom` resume without resending, bounded-concurrency stride lanes capped at `10`<!-- -->, `30`<!-- -->-message free-limit pacing plus optional `chunkSize`<!-- -->/`chunkDelayMs` sleeps with `onProgress`<!-- -->, `retryable[]` with absolute `index` + `id` + `error` in completion order, `excludeIds` skips, `throwError` rethrow). Per-recipient sends reuse the exact `api.sendPoll` arg construction from [Ctx.renderPoll()](./gramstax.ctx.renderpoll.md) (duplicated here — not extracted — so `renderPoll` behavior is untouched). Per-recipient failures mirror the broadcast-media loop: `fallback-text` triggers a best-effort fallback-text send (nested failures ignored) while `retryable` is recorded and the loop continues.

## Example


```typescript
async handleAnnounceVote() {
  const userIds = [123456, 789012]
  const langs = [`en`, `id`]
  await this.renderBroadcastPoll(userIds, langs, null, {topic: `lunch`})
}
```
